# REQ: LANG-2481 LANG-2482 LANG-2483 LANG-2484
global
    maxconn 4096
    daemon
defaults
    mode http
    timeout connect 5s
# Public entry point
frontend web
    bind *:443 ssl crt /etc/ssl/site.pem
    acl is_api path_beg /api
    use_backend api if is_api
    default_backend app
backend api
    balance roundrobin
    server api1 10.0.0.1:8080 check
